Maya: FYI I opened a docs PR that changes the SDK streaming examples to the new generator-based API. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

docs-bot: PR 4321 opened by Maya — title: 'examples: migrate streaming/pagination snippets to async_generate()'

Igor: I skimmed it. Looks good but the TS snippet still uses the old `onData` callback pattern, we should switch to `for await` style.

Sam: Agreed. Also the Python example currently shows naive retry logic; we should add jitter/backoff util and show it as a compact helper. Keep it 6-8 lines max.

Leo: I can take TS + Go. For Go I'd prefer to show a `chan`-based iterator example instead of a big callback block — it's more idiomatic.

Maya: Checklist so we don't miss anything: 1) Update Python to async generator + retry helper 2) Replace TS callback with `for await (...)` 3) Go -> channel + context 4) Add short note about pagination cursor TTL 5) Fix broken link in the streaming overview page (it points to the old API)

Igor: For (1) here's a tiny Python pattern we can slot in:```python
async def stream_with_retry(client, prompt):
    async for chunk in client.async_generate(prompt, max_tokens=512):
        yield chunk

# retry wrapper (pseudocode)
async def with_backoff(gen_fn, *a, **kw):
    for attempt in range(3):
        try:
            async for item in gen_fn(*a, **kw):
                yield item
            return
        except transient_error:
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5 * (2 ** attempt) + random.random())
            continue
```

Sam: Nice. For the TS side I propose this short pattern:```ts
async function run() {
  const stream = client.asyncGenerate({ prompt: '...' });
  for await (const chunk of stream) {
    process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
  }
}
```

Leo: And Go example:```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
defer cancel()
ch := make(chan string)
go func() {
  defer close(ch)
  for chunk := range client.AsyncGenerate(ctx, prompt) {
    ch <- chunk.Text
  }
}()
for s := range ch {
  fmt.Print(s)
}
```

Maya: Great, please keep each snippet compact (<= 12 lines). Also include a one-line comment about when to use `async_generate` vs `sync_generate` (latency/streaming tradeoff).

Igor: There's an edge-case: pagination examples currently show reading `cursor` from response headers. New runtime returns `next_cursor` in JSON body. Need a tiny migration note and one-line sample to read `next_cursor` and call `list_items(cursor=...)`.

Sam: I can add that. Proposed snippet:```python
resp = await client.list_items(page_size=100)
items = resp.items
cursor = resp.get('next_cursor')
# to fetch next page: await client.list_items(cursor=cursor)
```

Leo: I'll send a quick patch to the Go pagination example too. Use `resp.NextCursor` struct field.

Maya: Who can do the link fix? The streaming overview currently links to /docs/api/old-streaming.

Igor: I can do a tiny commit to replace URL and add a redirect note in the release notes.

Maya: Awesome. If everyone can push their small edits to the PR branch by EOD today, I'll queue for review tomorrow morning. Ping me when done. :pray:

Sam: Pushing TS + pagination update now.

Leo: Go examples ready, pushed.

Igor: Link fix + Python retry helper pushed. Left a comment in the PR about the random jitter seed.

Maya: Verified all snippets render in the docs preview and the code samples lint clean. Merging after one more review from @docs. Thanks all! :tada:
